picks.title: Hackers exploit Cisco SD-WAN flaw to deploy custom KeyDrift malware
picks.summary: A newly identified advanced persistent threat (APT) group tracked as UAT-11473 was observed exploiting CVE-2026-20127, an authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controllers, to deploy a custom malware framework called KeyDrift. [...]

picks.title: New Cisco firewall zero-day exploited to crash SSL VPN devices
picks.summary: Cisco released security updates to patch a denial-of-service zero-day in Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Threat Defense (FTD) software that attackers are exploiting to remotely crash vulnerable firewall devices. [...]

picks.title: Claude Model Builds Exploits Across Major Browsers & OSes
picks.summary: An unreleased version of the AI model has found and chained multiple vulnerabilities in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux, Anthropic says.

picks.title: POLYMARKET RESUMES TRADING AFTER $2.65 MILLION EXPLOIT, SAYS THIRD-PARTY PROVIDER WAS COMPROMISED
Polymarket pauses trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
picks.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

picks.title: Chained PHP2Shell Exploit Roots 25 Servers, Including US Government Servers
Bubblemaps Traces $2.7 Million Outflow From Polymarket Breach
picks.summary: Trading is back online and Polymarket has pledged full reimbursement, while a trader cited in the tracing says he moved funds to safety.

picks.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
picks.summary: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.

picks.summary: Tech whizz internet-accessible Synology NAS gets bit by transomware attack — security updates 18 months out of date in a series of catastrophic errors

picks.title: Cyber Vulnerabilities Besiege Italy, Absent Clear Cause
picks.summary: Researchers can t quite explain why cyber threats look so different in Italy compared with everywhere else.

picks.title: Fake PS5 emulators are being used to steal gamers passwords — two well-known GitHub repos, including popular AnyPS5, get hit, infecting gamers computers with password-scraping malware
picks.summary: Malware disguised as two popular PS5 game emulators, distributed via GitHub, has been identified as stealing passwords from unsuspecting gamers.
